_readme: Edit this file to change what the board knows about. Each event: date (YYYY-MM-DD, Chicago), start/end hour (24h, end not included), lift (multiplier on that hour: 1.10 = +10%, 0.90 = -10%), kind (sports, college, local, holiday, school, retail), label, detail, source (URL you can check). Optional: closed:true marks the store closed all day; confidence notes a conflict. Lifts are starting guesses until POS history shows the real effect. Times verified 2026-10-19.

schoolCalendar._note: Shelby County Schools 2026-2027 district calendar (Chelsea schools). Bell 7:35 AM-3:00 PM at CHS.

events.label: CHS football vs Chilton County, 7 PM (home)
events.detail: Region game at Chelsea High Stadium. Family meals and tailgate before kickoff.

events.label: Post-game drive-thru
events.detail: Final whistle ~9:15. Late chicken run before the 10 PM close.

events.label: LSU at Auburn, 11 AM CT
events.detail: Home game at Jordan-Hare. US-280 is the road from Birmingham to Auburn — tailgate biscuit runs.

events.label: Texas A&M at Alabama, 2:30 PM CT
events.detail: Watch-party lunch and family-meal pickup.

events.label: CHS football at Bessemer City, 7 PM (away)
events.detail: Away night: some families leave town. MaxPreps (updated Oct 18) says Fri 10/30; AHSFHS and 280 Living list Thu 10/29. Confirm and move this entry if needed.

events.label: Chelsea Boo Run 5K (8 AM) + kids 1K (9:30) + trunk-or-treat at CHS
events.detail: CHS cross country & track fundraiser at the stadium, 10510 County Rd 11.

events.label: Auburn at Ole Miss, 11:45 AM CT
events.detail: Away game on SEC Network. Watch-party lunch. Alabama is off this week.

events.label: Halloween night
events.detail: Trick-or-treat keeps families out of the lane. Guess — check against last year's 10/31 POS.

events.label: General Election Day (polls 7 AM–7 PM)
events.detail: Small midday lift from voters out on the 280 corridor. Guess.

events.label: Arkansas at Auburn (early kick, 11 AM–noon CT window)
events.detail: Home game, Military Appreciation. Morning 280 traffic toward Auburn. Exact kick set ~6 days before.

events.label: Alabama at LSU (flex: 2:30–3:30 or 5–7 PM CT)
events.detail: Watch-party family meals. Narrow this window once the SEC sets the kick.

events.label: Veterans Day — schools and county offices closed
events.detail: The no-school lift is applied from the school calendar; this entry is a reminder. Adjust once POS shows the effect.

events.label: Auburn at Mississippi State + Alabama at Vanderbilt (both early)
events.detail: Two away games in the 11 AM–noon CT window. Watch-party lunch.

events.label: Samford at Auburn, 2:30 PM CT
events.detail: Home game, smaller crowd. 280 traffic toward Auburn late morning.

events.label: Chattanooga at Alabama, 1 PM CT
events.detail: SEC Network+. Light watch-party lunch.

events.label: Thanksgiving Day
events.detail: Guess. Confirm store hours; if the store is closed, add "closed": true to this entry.

events.label: Iron Bowl: Auburn at Alabama (flex: 2:30–3:30 or 5–7 PM CT)
events.detail: Biggest watch-party day of the year. Family meals and 8/12-piece orders. Narrow the window once the kick is set.

events.label: Chelsea Christmas Tree Lighting, 6–9 PM at City Hall
events.detail: 2nd annual, City Hall lawn, 11611 Chelsea Rd. Hundreds attended in 2025. Dinner on the way in.

events.label: Tree Lighting let-out
events.detail: Families heading home after 9 PM — late drive-thru.

events.label: Chelsea Christmas Parade, 10 AM
events.detail: Thousands of spectators. 2025 route ran from Chelsea Middle School to Aldi on Chelsea Corners Way; check the 2026 parade map (posted early December) for road closures near 280.

events.label: Post-parade lunch
events.detail: Parade crowd heads home past the 280 frontage.

events.label: Christmas Day
events.detail: Guess. Confirm store hours; if closed, add "closed": true.

events.label: New Year's Day
events.detail: Guess. Late start, bowl-game afternoon. Confirm store hours.

_history: Past dated days. Not forecast; used only so the board can learn holiday uplift from your daily or hourly sales (actual vs the same-weekday median). Lifts match the future entries' starting guesses. Add past local events (games, parades) here too, with a source.
